text.card: A star about 16 parsecs away, 1.2 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.2 solar radii and 0.94 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,663 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: 51 Pegasi
quotes.card: 51 Pegasi, also named Helvetios, is a Sun-like star located 50.6 light-years from Earth in the constellation of Pegasus.
quotes.introduction: It was the first main-sequence star found to have an exoplanet orbiting it.
